decisions.reason: The responsive website template is close to the core hosting and agency offer, so despite limited visible commitment and weaker strategic centrality than other products, management would still be inclined to continue it unless clear failure became undeniable.

Premium customer support sits at the heart of the firm's stated strategy of tailored expert service, making withdrawal unlikely because prior investment and strategic self-justification strongly favor continuation.

The software version management tool builds on the firm's technical platform and automation goals, so a medium-sized German hosting firm with in-house development would be prone to persist with it after having publicly established it.

Scalable hosting for agencies was presented as a flagship direction and offered in several models, so escalation of commitment is especially strong and management would be very reluctant to retreat from it within the coming year.
